evidence.note: TodoWrite invoked six times, well-distributed from opening through verification phase — an explicitly maintained, regularly-updated checklist of work state across the broad surface.
Systematic sequential build of all ~12 resources (customers through restricted_keys), indicating the agent tracked which resources remained and worked through them without dropping any.

Distinct targeted verification per tricky subsystem — webhook retry/signing (92-94), concurrent idempotency serialization (97), SDK compat (99), boot contract (102-104), env vars (107) — going beyond happy-path existence to check edge behavior.

Churn cluster while blocked on a boot/formparsers issue, but the agent diagnosed the true cause (stale server processes: found at 85, killed 86, fresh restart 87, then clean smoke test 89) rather than looping on code edits — recognized the stuck state and changed tactic.

reasoning: The agent kept a genuine, repeatedly-updated todo checklist and ran targeted verification for each tricky subsystem, and it broke out of a boot-blocking loop by diagnosing stale processes rather than thrashing — behavior above the '5' anchor (usable checklist, generally notices blocks). It falls short of 8 because, from the visible evidence, I cannot confirm the tracking accurately separated 'verified' from 'merely implemented' across the whole surface, so I place it at 6, between the 5 and 8 anchors.
